Description: Adds +50 to any rolls for one slow moving maneuver (e.g., walking a 3" beam, etc.)
Allows caster to disjoint limbs, contract muscles, etc. to escape manacles/ropes and to slip through small places (+25 to +50 to Contortion maneuvers)
Allows caster to alter the form of his face. The caster may specify a specific person, but the change will not be exact
For the duration, the caster can breathe water but not air

Caster can alter his form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form cannot be a specific form. For example, a human caster could take on the form of a Dwarf, but the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., the target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the Dwarves' ability to see in the dark). The caster can only alter his size by up to 25%. See Section 7.1.11
As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any gas as normal air
As Face Shifting, except lasts 1 hour per level
As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any air, water, and/or gas, at will
As Change to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within 50% to 200% of the caster's current mass; does not confer any special abilities
Caster becomes as if made of very dense stone (cannot move or cast spells)
As Change, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell. The change takes one round of concentration
Caster takes the form of a liquid mass, able to seep through cracks as well as water. As a fluid, he can move through water at a rate of 10 mph. The caster may not cast spells while in this form
Caster takes the form of a mist, able to fly at a rate of 20 mph. The caster may seep through cracks, extend himself to become virtually invisible, etc. The caster may not cast spells in this form
As Waterform and Mistform, except the two forms are interchangeable at will. Changin from one form to another takes one round of concentration

As Changing and Form Master, except all forms are interchangeable at will. Each change takes one round of concentration. The caster may vary his mass between 10% and 1000% of his own mass. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.1.11 for more on the abilities gained/retained when changing forms. CLOSED MENTALISM 4.2.7 SHIFTING
